pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with highly serrated and diffuse edge gradients. Pixel-level transitions between light corridors and dark patches show a feathered texture rather than sharp lines. Patches on the mid-flank are larger and more elongated than those on the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, generally narrowing at junction nodes where three or more patches converge. The network forms a complex reticulated topological graph across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the upper neck, consisting of a dense, low-amplitude fringe of vertical hair fibers creating a fuzzy, serrated 1D silhouette against the out-of-focus background.
